PR #37376 on card #35231. Read: the card body and its seven comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff of the eleven files against `main` (merge base), and the 48 check-runs on this head. Nothing was built, checked out or re-run; the verbatim reading below is a line comparison of git objects.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Verbatim move: right.** Compared as line multisets over the nine `.claude/**` files, merge base against head: 147 lines leave, 146 of them re-appear byte for byte in a reference file and the one that does not is the reworded `dogfood-verification/SKILL.md:74`. The lines that are new are the six pointer lines, nine title, heading and key lines in the four new files, the reworded dogfood line, and blank lines. No rule sentence is altered, dropped or split in transit.
- **`pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`: right.** The diff is five deleted lines and nothing else; the decision frame above them is untouched. Line 145 (the blocker-grade line) is at head, byte for byte as on `main`, and `references/state-machine.md:35` still says the same rule in its own words. Both stay.
- **Byte sizes at head equal their rows: right.** 33351, 5589, 33504, 14209, 2627, 3555, 4553, 1261, each equal to its `CEILINGS` row, headroom 0. `dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` is 9525 under an unchanged 9526.
- **`Rule-change: none`: right.** No changed hunk alters what an agent may do without the maintainer, what gets done and in what order, or what must go to him. The three authority sentences inside the five lines moved out of `SKILL.md` (a same-direction four-facet block is no licence to rule in his place; the weight ranks recommendations and authorises nothing; security, permission and hard-to-undo actions stay on the human floor) arrive unchanged in `decision-analysis.md:48-51`, and the floor they restate is still in the always-loaded file at `SKILL.md:30`, `:224` and `:279`. A file move with unchanged words is not a rule change.
- **The security line above reads yes on the literal reading, not for a new teaching.** Lines that arrive in `closure.md` (a security finding gets no card and no `Extracted:` line) and in `decision-analysis.md:48` (the security and permission boundary stays on the human floor) are changed hunks that carry security-handling words, so `no` cannot be written. They are verbatim relocations. No `hits` path is under `skills/**` or `ui/skills/**`, so the brief's label clause does not fire on this record.
- **Gate verdicts are the check-runs.** 48 on this head: no failure; `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test Core`, `TypeScript Type Check` all success. The one `cancelled` run (PR-body guards 139609443723) is superseded on the same head by 139609611905, success.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff publishes nothing — nine files under `.claude/**`, a comment in `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, and comment plus data rows in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. No package, schema or published `skills/**` file changes.
`Clause-②: no` on the PR body equals the claim's line and is right: no narrowing, no accept-set change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Open question 1 (the map total rises 1163 B through four new rows): option A, accept.** The arithmetic holds at head: the four lowered or moved rows net −10833 (−568, +566, −5482, −5349) and the four new rows add 11996. No existing row rises except `decision-analysis.md`, and that raise is the declared move. A new row is not a raise: the map is an enumeration, a file with no row has no ceiling at all (`instrument-discipline.md` has none on `main`), so the four rows add ceilings where the alternative was none. The bytes that are new text, six pointer lines and the titles, headings and key lines, are ordered by the ruling of record on the card, quoted from its body: "Each keeps what every run needs. Everything else moves to a reference file that is read only on the path that needs it. No rule changes meaning." under the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z). A pointer and a title are what that sentence asks for; paying for them by deleting rule text would break its last clause.
- **Open question 2 (`SKILL.md` shrinks 1.7%; stop or follow up): the card's done-when is met as written** (three files shorter, every moved block reached by a pointer, gates green), so the closing keyword is not wrong. See N5 for the part the seat's ACCEPT owes.
- **Deviation, ratchet header left stale at the report head:** closed by the claim addendum 7178597850 and commit `f3a092b8e`; the header sentence at head names the `checklist-test` references/.
- **Out-of-scope note, two sentences naming `os-dev.md` as the home of the ablation procedure:** both fixed at head (dogfood line 74, preflight comment lines 295-296).
- **SQL push-down:** no code path, no query, no id materialisation in this diff. Nothing to flag.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`.** Seven blocks leave, four pointers arrive. Judged block by block for whether an always-loaded guard is now behind a pointer a dev may not follow at the decisive moment:
- Ablation and reverse verification (`dev-ablation.md`): the trigger stays in the entry file (line 208, when an ablation is owed; line 181, when a reverse verification is owed) and the pointer directly under it is unconditional and timed before the act. Every ⛔ in the block (no bare restore, no skipped restore leg, no exit code as proof, the `trap` hard line) applies only inside that act. Holds.
- Shallow-checkout ancestry: the pointer is keyed on the same command the block was keyed on, timed before the reading, and its anchor matches the heading at `dev-traps.md:18`. Holds.
- `packages/cli` and boot-path tiers: the rule that decides what is owed locally stays at line 216; the pointer names both surfaces the block covers. Holds.
- Toolchain traps: line 115 names every surface the twelve moved bullets cover, and the one trap any run can hit (a zero-script `pnpm --filter` exits 0) stays in place. Holds, with N1.
- The `## Toolchain traps` heading stays, so `AGENTS.md:162` still lands on a heading. The sentence it cites (the bare `--` separator) is at `os-dev.md:96` on `main` and at head alike, outside that section in both; this PR does not make it worse.
- This is the first time `os-dev.md` points into `pm-dispatch/references/`. `dispatch-runbook.md:135` already tells a card thread to read references on demand, and the spelling is the one `checklist-test/SKILL.md` uses for `security-findings.md`. Holds.

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/decision-analysis.md`.** The five lines land at the end of 〈落卡分析模板〉, beside the recommendation rules already there (lines 38-42), and are reached by `SKILL.md:240` and `:275`, both of which predate this PR. Whoever writes a recommendation for a card or a decision thread reads that template; a dev never loaded `SKILL.md`. Holds, with N4.

**`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`, `references/closure.md`, `references/standing-regression.md`.** Both section headings stay; the 「验证重测」 paragraph stays, so `RUNNER.md:1037` still lands. The §5 pointer is unconditional and timed (after the record is filed, before it is closed), which is the moment every ⛔ in the moved body applies. The §6 pointer names the two routines by name. `scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` matches the protocol lines by its own regex and reads no skill file. Holds, with N2 and N3.

**`.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md:74`.** Names the new home, which carries all three things the sentence lists. Holds.

**`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.** `CROSS_FILE_MOVES`: `was` 5023 and the source's 33919 are the `main` values; the raise is +566 against a source decrease of 568, so condition (a) holds with 2 B to spare; the declaration names `RULING_CITATION`, condition (c). No other existing row rises. `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES`: the widest row in `closure.md` at head is 214 B and the widest left in `checklist-test/SKILL.md` is 221 B, each equal to its pin. The header sentence agrees with the map.

**`scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`.** Comment only; the three homes it asks to keep in step are still three and still exist.

**Readers of the old locations.** None reads text that moved. `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` reads the trailer rule in `os-dev.md`, untouched. `check-skill-frame-sync.mjs` reads the decision frame, untouched. `check-agent-test-spelling.mjs` walks the whole `.claude` root, so the command spellings that moved (`exec vitest run --project unit`, `git checkout HEAD --`) stay inside its population. `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` takes `os-dev.md` as an extra file beside its walk. No script, workflow or hook carries a phrase of the moved lines; `label-write`, `check-governed-prose`, `record-recognisers` and `check-expected-skips` anchor on `SKILL.md` text this PR leaves in place.

Nits, none with an effect on correctness or the contract:
- N1 (nit) — `os-dev.md:115` ends 「碰到才读」, which can be read as "once you have hit it"; the other three pointers say 「前读」. The surfaces are named and the reference title says 「碰到该面才读」, so the reading is recoverable. 「动到这些面前读」 would remove the doubt for the ⛔ lines behind it (`playwright install`, the OSV upper bound).
- N2 (nit) — section references now take two hops: `standing-regression.md:13,16` says 「§5 的 Supersede」 and 「§5 的冒烟例外」, `closure.md` says 「§6」, `lanes/qa.md:12-13` says 「照 §6」; each lands on a `SKILL.md` section that is now a pointer to the other reference file. Every hop resolves.
- N3 (nit) — the §5 body opens 「收口是每一轮运行的一部分」, and that sentence moved with it. The block is needed by every run that files a record, so it is not one-path in the card's sense; the unconditional pointer keeps it reached, and a run that files a record still loads fewer bytes than before (14209 + 4553 against 19558).
- N4 (nit) — `decision-analysis.md:3` says the file binds `needs-user-decision` cards and decision-box discussion only, while the five lines that arrived were written under 〈升级与决策〉 for every recommendation. The simple-question path is covered inside the same file, so no recommendation path falls outside it today.
- N5 (nit) — the PR body says about 7 KB of one-path text stays in `SKILL.md` and that no card is filed on the maintainer's word; that word is not on the card thread. The seat's ACCEPT should name the carrier for that remainder, or say there is none and why, since the closing keyword closes the card.
